omitted.reason: The token format has no motion family — motion rules live in motion.md

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground. A warm off-white — never pure grey — so white cards read as objects on it.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards and panels. Flat: no border, no shadow; the step up from bg is the whole separation.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Recessed fills inside a card: inputs, answer tiles, ghost buttons, chart tooltips' ground.

tokens.name: surface-3
tokens.usage: Hover state of surface-2 fills, neutral badges, source-tag chips. States move one surface step, they never add borders.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Dim layer behind modals — warm-tinted, not pure black.

tokens.name: hero-scrim
tokens.usage: Chip ground on hero/accent bands (share-modal close button). 55% white — lets the art show through while keeping icon contrast.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers only (report summary underline, header rule). Cards never use it.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Rare stronger rule when a hairline vanishes on surface-2.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary ink — a deep coffee brown, not black. Headings, body, button labels on gold.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary ink: descriptions, hints, section labels. Also the hull/mast brown in illustrations.

tokens.name: text-subtle
tokens.usage: Tertiary ink: timestamps, empty states, placeholder text.

tokens.name: text-inverse
tokens.usage: Label ink on accent fills. Gold is light, so the 'inverse' is the same dark brown — by design.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Ink on gold elements. Aliases text — follows any ink change (same role as text-inverse; declared in :root).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: THE action color. Primary buttons, active toggles, progress bar, focus. One accent does all interactive work.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Accent hover — lighter, not darker: the button brightens under the cursor.

tokens.name: accent-press
tokens.usage: Accent pressed state, paired with a scale(0.97) dip.

tokens.name: accent-weak
tokens.usage: Small-area gold tints: selected chips, quote highlights, flash-on-scroll. Large areas use a solid — alpha over grey goes muddy. (= accent at 16% alpha.)

tokens.name: gold-400
tokens.usage: Bright gold for illustration highlights (jib sail, sun) and small marks. Aliases accent-hover — there is only one bright gold.

tokens.name: gold-700
tokens.usage: Readable gold: links and gold text on light grounds, where accent itself fails contrast.

tokens.name: green-500
tokens.usage: Semantic positive: 'What's going well' bullets, success badges, high mood scores.

tokens.name: green-weak
tokens.usage: Positive tint fill — the green report box, success badge ground.

tokens.name: red-500
tokens.usage: Semantic negative: 'What to improve' markers, low mood, destructive buttons.

tokens.name: red-weak
tokens.usage: Negative tint ground — the red report box.

tokens.name: tooltip-ink
tokens.usage: Tooltip ground: deep warm brown under white text — the one dark surface in the UI.

tokens.name: tooltip-text
tokens.usage: Text on tooltips. The only pure-white text allowed — appears on tooltip-ink only.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Focus ring, drawn as a 2px box-shadow on inputs. The value is accent at 50% alpha; alpha cannot be expressed by reference, so the literal stays.

styles.name: headline-lg
styles.sample: Honest team feedback, minus the awkward.

styles.name: headline-sm
styles.usage: Card and section headings (h2–h4 map here automatically).

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: Stat numbers only (participation, response count, average mood). Digits, never sentences.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Pairing clearly paid off this sprint; requirement sync is still the friction.
styles.usage: Reserved for the AI report's summary quote.

styles.name: body-md
styles.sample: Pairing on the auth refactor sped up work and caught edge cases.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: What people opening the shared link can see.
styles.usage: Descriptions and hints. Button labels use the button style.

styles.name: label-lg
styles.usage: Sub-headings inside cards: report boxes, sidebar cards, stat labels.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Button labels — body family. Geometry lives on the Button component. Landing hero CTA exception: 48px tall, 16px label (the only 16px in the system).

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase kickers and speech-bubble speaker labels on the landing scene.

spacing.note: Built on the Tailwind 4px grid; these are the steps the product actually uses.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight sibling gaps: tag rows, dot bullets.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: List item gaps (answer cards, report bullets).

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Padding inside tint boxes; grid gaps between cards. Also the minimum page side gutter.

tokens.name: space-5x
tokens.usage: Card inline padding — pairs with space-5 (20px block).

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between stacked sections in a column.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Page-level breathing room around heroes and empty states.

radius.note: Restrained, Supabase-like corners. Small enough to feel technical, round enough to feel warm.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Toggle track and knob, source-tag chips, chart bars' caps.

shadow.note: Surfaces stay flat — a card never casts a shadow. Only layers that float above the page (menus, modals) lift, and the shadow is warm-toned.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Dropdown menus, popovers, landing speech bubbles.

illustration.note: Extended illustration palette — inline SVG art only (LandingScene, RoleIcon, TemplateBanner, TemplateIcon, QuestionIcon, ShareHeroArt, FillWizard stickers). Extension colors must never enter the UI: interface chrome uses the core colors above.
